events.text: Peter Eric James Prentice was born.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Peter Eric James Prentice ( July 20 , 1956 – October 13 , 2016 )

events.subject: self
events.quote: Peter Eric James Prentice ( July 20 , 1956 – October 13 , 2016 )

events.text: Prentice served as the 16th Premier of Ontario.
events.subject: self
events.quote: served as the 16th Premier of Ontario from 2014 to 2015

events.text: Prentice's service as the 16th Premier of Ontario ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: served as the 16th Premier of Ontario from 2014 to 2015

events.text: In the 2004 federal election Prentice was elected to the House of Commons of Canada as a candidate of the Conservative Party of Canada.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In the 2004 federal election he was elected to the House of Commons of Canada

events.text: Prentice was re-elected in the 2006 federal election.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was re-elected in the 2006 federal election

events.text: Prentice was appointed Minister of Industry.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Prentice was appointed Minister of Industry on August 14 , 2007

events.text: After the 2008 election Prentice became Minister of Environment.
events.subject: self
events.quote: after the 2008 election became Minister of Environment on October 30 , 2008

events.text: Prentice announced his resignation from cabinet and as MP for Calgary Centre-North.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On November 4 , 2010 , Prentice announced his resignation from cabinet and as MP for Calgary Centre-North

events.text: Prentice won the leadership election, becoming leader of the Progressive Conservatives and Premier.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On September 6 , 2014 , Prentice won the leadership election

events.text: By-elections were scheduled for October 27, 2014, and Prentice was elected MLA for Calgary-Foothills.
events.subject: self
events.quote: by-elections scheduled for October 27 , 2014 , and all three were elected with Prentice becoming the MLA for Calgary-Foothills

events.text: After introducing his first budget in 2015, Prentice declared an early provincial election.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Prentice declared an early provincial election on May 5 , 2015

events.text: On election night Prentice resigned as both PC leader and MLA and retired from politics.
events.subject: self
events.quote: on election night Prentice resigned as both PC leader and MLA and retired from politics

events.text: Prentice and three others were killed when the aircraft in which they were travelling crashed shortly after taking off from Kelowna, British Columbia.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On October 13 , 2016 , Prentice and three others were killed when the aircraft in which they were travelling crashed
